Evan —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and for attaching the W-9. I pulled the portal logs and the automated IRS API returned a mismatch flag for the EIN; that flag prevents automatic PO creation.

Options we accept to clear the EIN flag (ranked by typical SLA):
1) 147C from the IRS confirming EIN (gold standard; can take several days)
2) Notarized company bank letter showing EIN and account details (1–3 business days)
3) Video-notary walk-through recorded via our vendor validation partner + live verification of the same representative who signed the W-9 (fastest; acceptable as an exception for first-time vendors under $250k annually)

If you prefer (3), we can provide a short script for the video and a single DocuSign acknowledgement instead of a wet-notary. I attached our internal evidence checklist so you can see the acceptance criteria.

Next steps: tell me which route you prefer and who will be the signatory so we can schedule the video window or issue the PO hold-lift. If we get the video and DocuSign within 48 hours, procurement can fast-track the PO.

Attachment: redwood_evidence_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Soojin Lee
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

Evan —

Finance approves a video-notary exception for this PO provided the following acceptance criteria are met (procurement exception memo is attached to the vendor record):

Acceptance checklist for video-notary pathway (required):
- Video must include the signer stating full name, title, company legal name, and the EIN exactly as printed on the W-9; show government photo ID alongside the face-to-camera for liveness.
- Signer must show the same signed W-9 on camera and state the date of signature.
- If available, show the redacted bank letter or bank statement with EIN visible; otherwise DocuSign acknowledgement + bank letter to follow within 3 business days.
- Video length: 60–180 seconds; must be unedited, recorded with timestamp visible in the file metadata or via the vendor portal upload.
- File format: mp4 or mov, H.264 codec preferred.
- DocuSign: signer to complete the attached acknowledgement template embedded here: https://docusign.example.com/embedded/signon?doc=sample-notary-script

If you confirm you can meet those items we will lift the PO hold and push the PO through once the video and DocuSign are received and validated by our vendor validation partner (approx 4 hours after receipt).

Evan — if helpful I can schedule a 15-min window for our validation partner to run the video session with your signer so we make sure metadata and visibility are correct.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
